pages.text: “Mellow and smooth, aged with time, silver buds unfurl, bringing renewed vitality.”$(br2)White Tea is a delicately sweet and refreshing beverage made from two portions of dried white tea leaves. The tea has a clear, pale yellow hue with a mild taste. Drinking it grants slow health regeneration, making travels safer.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare White Tea, $(br)boil two portions of dried white tea leaves.$(br)It is best consumed during recovery periods, allowing for gradual health restoration.

Upon drinking White Tea, travelers gain a health regeneration effect, slowly restoring health over time.$(br)This is a gentle and long-lasting restorative tea, ideal for sustained recovery.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
